propositions: Closing a ticket with no file impact declared in its accepted scope currently scans the entire git history and resolves all historical ticket references before determining that landing enforcement is out of scope.
The unconditional call to _referencing_commits occurs before the _check_file_impact_vs_diff guard, causing discarded work on the empty-impact path.
Adding an early guard based on the union of file impact for the ticket and accepted descendants will skip commit discovery and return before unnecessary repository-history processing.
Tickets or descendants with any declared file impact must retain existing commit-presence discovery and diff-enforcement checks.
The fix must preserve existing behavior for administrative disposition, force, descendant-credit, and completion-verifier semantics.
